main_text.p: mata: mactantes invicem, & devorantes homines:imò viscera sua, in viscera sua regerentes matres: Quæ cursim transeo,enecant enim immorantem:Cuncta interim hæc iisdem Legatis, per Starram Russam iter suum profequentibus, tum oculis, tum fide dignis testibus comperta. Pergit porrò Gœterus, & aliam tragœdiam adjungit: Irrepserant, inquit, Novogroodtæ in culinam noftram tres Ruffi juvenes, qui coquo spe micarum miniftrabant: Horum unus cum infirmari cæpisset, noćte quadam ab aliis duobus in focum conjectus est: Invidiâ scilicet, quod offæ inter tres partitæ,minor portio veniret ad singulos: Postridie semitoftum cadaver, cum nidore in licibus repertum: quod hospes, nihil casu consternatus,forcipibus detulit in fterquilinium. Sed quod ibi-

page.notes: Catchword "ibi-" is the first word of the next page. The faint marginal fragments on the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Several words are set with irregular spacing in the print; "noćte" and "fterquilinium" reproduce the printed forms.
